name: quotum-hub
description: The Quotum hub: stores what agents measure and serves the dashboard of coding-agent subscription limits (Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity).
author: Sergey Padurets

scripts.check: devkit-verify && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck
scripts.lint: eslint --max-warnings 0 eslint.config.mjs prettier.config.mjs vite.config.ts vite.bundle.config.ts vite.demo.config.ts server && eslint --max-warnings 0 ui && eslint --max-warnings 0 demo bench
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.server.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.ui-test.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.demo.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.demo-ui.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.scripts.json
scripts.fix: pnpm run format && eslint --max-warnings 0 --fix eslint.config.mjs prettier.config.mjs vite.config.ts vite.bundle.config.ts vite.demo.config.ts server && eslint --max-warnings 0 --fix ui && eslint --max-warnings 0 --fix demo bench && pnpm run format
scripts.test: node server/secrets/build-windows.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json && node server/secrets/build-windows.mjs --dist && node -e "const {spawnSync}=require('node:child_process');const w=/^[1-9]\d*$/.test(process.env.DEVKIT_TEST_WORKERS??'')?['--test-concurrency='+process.env.DEVKIT_TEST_WORKERS]:[];const files=process.argv.length>1?process.argv.slice(1):['server/test/*.test.ts','ui/test/*.test.ts','demo/test/*.test.ts','bench/test/*.test.ts'];const r=spawnSync(process.execPath,['--import','tsx','--test',...w,'--test-reporter=@docouno/env/node-test-reporter',...files],{stdio:'inherit'});process.exit(r.status??1)"
scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');fs.mkdirSync('dist',{recursive:true});for(const e of fs.readdirSync('dist'))fs.rmSync('dist/'+e,{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json && node server/secrets/build-windows.mjs --dist && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json && vite build
scripts.dev: pnpm run build && node --import tsx demo/index.ts
scripts.demo:keys: vite build --configLoader native --config vite.demo.config.ts && node --import tsx demo/keys-server.ts
